**RESUME HERE (localfold for hv's compact, 2026-09-17): ST0076 WP-03 is built and banked green in targeted runs, and its whole gate waits on ic's WP-04 landing; 0434 is built and banked; the devbin toolchain line is dc's to bank; WP-06 starts with vc's _build question.** RECOVER any worktree: a fresh worktree at the bank's base, then `git cat-file -p <ref> | git apply` for each bank in order.
WP-03: scratchpad/wt-wp03 = c800b8319 + cc's shapes (refs/bank/cc/st0076-extractor-shapes, patch-id 69d6653d) + refs/bank/dc/st0076-wp03-wip (blob ad0f1a0ba, patch-id 0b437423: elixir.scm, symbols.rs EXTRACTOR_VERSION 3, suite.rs, tests/symbols_are_qualified_elixir_references.rs naming AT-03.1). The worktree equals the banks. Green in targeted runs: AC-03.1's arms (reworded at ee6e39e84 to take local captures), the symbol and index families; clippy -p intentsvcs clean. vc's rulings on the texts: what_a_reference_misses("elixir") is clauses 1 and 2 only ("in Elixir, nothing import or use brings in is applied, so a call to an imported function, Kernel's included, is a level-1 reference with no module; and a call through a module held in a variable, such as mod.fun(..), has no qualifier"); level_words(2) as drafted ("read from the file's syntax with the qualifier it was written with, a Rust path as written or an Elixir module with the file's own aliases and __MODULE__ expanded, still never resolved to the definition it names"); the register prose is ic's to word; the do: keyword-body alias rule goes into design.md's Elixir cells, not the sentence.
NEXT, in order: (1) cc lands 0433, ic lands WP-04 (stacked on 0433); then rebase dc's stack onto that HEAD, carrying the Elixir sentence, level_words(2) and the dispatch-table regen (surface/dispatch-table.json, then intent/st/ST0056/parity/tools/gen_dispatch_table.sh) in dc's bank. (2) Take the whole-suite slot from vc, sending START and END to vc, cc and ic; run the gate ONCE as the train's judging run in the warm worktree: fmt, workspace clippy -D warnings, cargo build -p intentd, whole intentsvcs, intent-cli and intentd suites --no-fail-fast under the isolated HOME; send vc the log paths, both patch-ids, the base, the path list and the load. (3) On vc's word, land right after cc's shapes landing, which brings the design table's Rust cells to WP-02: commit, `at new` AT-03.1 taken green, WP-03's objective (draft at scratchpad/wp03-objective.md; add local captures), design.md's Elixir cells on the then-current file with the do: keyword rule, `wp done`.
0434: refs/bank/dc/0434 (blob 592bdb984, patch-id 559fe1da, base ee6e39e84, intentd only): a `warning: ` token on every remedy notice the sweep found without one, ingest's doubled remedy removed, and arm tests/every_notice_with_a_remedy_says_its_severity_once.rs (red on the baseline source, green on the fix), with the scan helpers moved into tests/common. It lands after WP-03 as a train of one, its whole suite in a free slot. vc RULED both calls: (a) the artefacts remedy an ingest gives for a store busy past the 5 s wait (intentsvcs facade.rs:2297) is a separate issue, dc's, filed as 0436 at this fold; it lands after 0434 as its own train of one, with FacadeError::Ingest delegating to a busy-store remedy; (b) ic removes ConsoleLine.swift:55's dead `intentd: could not` guess and brings ConsoleTests.swift:73 and :111 to the tokened shape as a second bank on 0434's train, landing right behind it.
DEVBIN (hv's ruling via vc): toolchain arms stay out of CI and run here. Bank refs/bank/dc/devbin-toolchain: a second `commands.test.options` entry in bin/.devbin/config.yaml beside `rust`, the same cargo test line plus `-- --ignored needs_the_toolchain`, its comment saying why it has no CI twin; `test.rust.run` stays identical to rust.yml. Confirm from devbin's source that `test all` and `fullcycle` run every option; never run fullcycle to find out. cc is told it probably carries the line with the first needs_the_toolchain arm (WP-05); dc carries it if WP-06's lands first.
WP-06 (after WP-03), verb `intent index resolve` (hv agreed): BEFORE building, answer vc from a scratch copy of Laksa whether resolve compiles into the project's own _build, and whether MIX_BUILD_PATH under intent/.cache isolates cleanly and at what first-run cost; announce the compile window first. Then stack on cc's core (refs/bank/cc/st0076-l3-core, WP-05's first bank: one row per path, line, name and target, no tie-break at write, staleness once per file, target path and line from def rows). The Elixir toolchain arm is `#[ignore = "needs elixir on PATH; bin/devbin test all runs it"]` in a module path containing needs_the_toolchain, failing by name when the tool is absent. Store writes go through the installed pair only. NO RELEASE, NO PUSH.
